{"consolidated_memory":"**Plan drift recurring issue in infra/terraform/vpc.tf (VPC module)**

Work site: infra/terraform/vpc.tf, infrastructure side. Stack: HCL. Covering check: terraform plan check in CI.

Symptom (all occasions): Repro is running plan twice with no changes in between. Signal is a diff on a resource nobody edited.

---

**Occasion 1: [2026-01-29] - Payloads above ~2 MB**
- Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- PR #2948, branch fix/plan-drift-2
- Result: 56 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Note: same corner of vpc.tf as earlier plan drift work, context carried over

**Occasion 2: [2026-02-26] - First request after cold start**
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #3636, branch fix/plan-drift-3
- Result: memory settled at 305 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB

**Occasion 3: [2026-03-31] - Input list came in empty**
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #3782, branch fix/plan-drift-4
- Result: reclaimed 97 GB of blob storage
- Note: same corner of vpc.tf as earlier plan drift work, context carried over

**Occasion 4: [2026-08-30] - Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys**
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #8726, branch fix/plan-drift-8
- Result: throughput rose 31 percent to 654 requests per second"}
